summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Job Status Timeline and AI Image Upload features for SignGuy AI. All backend APIs (13 tests) passed. Frontend UI verified for Timeline, AI Tools page with all 15 tools, and image upload functionality.

visual_flow_diagram.details: Visual status flow shows Quoted → Approved → In Production → Installed → Complete with green checkmarks for completed stages and highlighted current stage

status_change_history.details: Status Change History section displays old_status, new_status, timestamps (e.g., 'Feb 17, 2026, 01:59 PM'), and time in previous status (e.g., '0 min in previous status', '2 min in previous status')

status_change_logs_activity.details: Changing job status via API logs activity with old_value and new_value fields

get_job_activities.details: GET /api/jobs/{id}/activities returns list with activity_type, description, created_at, old_value, new_value

all_15_tools_visible.details: AI Tools Suite page shows all 15 tools: Photo Enhancer Analyzer, Vectorization Analyzer, Font Identifier, AI Sign Designer, AI Banner Designer, Mockup Creator, Logo Creator, Branding Kit Generator, Business Copywriter, Document Composer, Pricing Intelligence Assistant, Social Media Job Post Creator, Social Media Pack Generator, Content Calendar Creator, Campaign Builder

category_filter.details: Category buttons work: Design Tools (6), Branding (2), Business (3), Marketing (4)

photo_enhancer_analyzer.details: Image upload field present with data-testid='input-image_upload', 'Click to Upload Image' button visible, accepts JPG/PNG/WebP

vectorization_analyzer.details: Image upload button present for vectorization analysis

font_identifier.details: Image upload button present for font identification

backend_image_handling.details: Backend successfully handles base64 image uploads in /api/ai/generate endpoint with FileContent

tagline_generator.details: POST /api/ai/generate with tool='tagline_generator' returns content with generated taglines

brand_color_advisor.details: POST /api/ai/generate with tool='brand_color_advisor' returns color recommendations

ai_history.details: GET /api/ai/history returns list of previous AI generations

page_loads.details: Job details page loads without errors, shows job name, status, customer, tabs (Line Items, Time, Notes, Activity, Timeline)

full_details_endpoint.details: GET /api/jobs/{id}/details returns job, customer, activities, job_items, notes, financial_snapshot

seed_data_creation: Used existing test job (Race Car Wrap Project) for timeline testing - no new data created
context_for_next_testing_agent: Job Status Timeline feature fully functional: Visual flow diagram shows 5 statuses with checkmarks for completed stages. Status Change History shows old→new status, timestamps, and time-in-previous-status. AI Tools page has all 15 tools across 4 categories (Design, Branding, Business, Marketing). Image upload works for Photo Enhancer, Vectorization Analyzer, and Font Identifier tools with base64 encoding to backend.
